name: 投票の質問入力
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. ONE real Lighthouse component LH03-0040「投票の質問入力」.
Image1 ORIGINAL controls the quiet section label, rounded white field proportions, actual populated/unfocused state and fine details. Image2 Japanese mock is secondary for exact copy, locked typography and logical390x94 layout; replace its mint field with white. Image3 approved white restrained styling only.
Small section label exact「質問」at24,8 logical, Meiryo Regular12px/16px, tracking0, gray#6E6E6E. Below it ONE rounded WHITE input358x46 at16,36 with fine neutral border,12px corners and very subtle separation. Exact populated question「昼食の後は何をしますか？」at32,47, Meiryo Regular14px/24px tracking0, dark#1D1D1D, single line. Preserve these exact Japanese characters and final full-width question mark. No bold heading. Unfocused state: no caret, focus ring, checkmark, icon, clear button or validation message.
Preserve original and native compact spacing, text baseline and padding under uniform scale. Purewhite#FFFFFF canvas and field. Accent evidence: this original question field is neutral; its unrelated ON switch elsewhere is a separate component. No selected/primary state here, so no forest-green button, mint tint or decorative accent.
ONE complete shortwide component prominently centered on landscape with modest margins and no clipping. Exclude poll header/Cancel/Send, options, switch, phone and other form sections. Static raster candidate; no actual input behavior or poll sent.
reviewNotes: 原画像の中立な質問ラベル/白い未フォーカス入力を主参照、モックを質問/昼食の後は何をしますか？とRegular12/16・14/24の副参照。出力を目視し全文/終端疑問符・通常ウエイト階層・白面/細い中立枠・余計な記号/ボタン/選択状態なしを確認。質問欄には機能色が不要なのでミントを白へ。厳密字体/寸法計測・実入力/投票送信・編集可能性・所有者承認は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
